_comment: Default configuration for the calendar addon. Override any key in app-custom-config.json.
_comment_calendar_manage: #1220 — the calendar addon declares the permission its management routes ask for, and grants it to admin. A deployment grants calendar-manage to its own role (a clubhouse manager, say) in app-custom-config.json: add the role to the subjects of calendar-manage-access, or add a policy of your own. The addon never names a role.

calendar-manage.description: Create, edit and delete calendar events; see private reservation details; cancel any reservation
calendar-manage.label: Manage calendar events and everyone's reservations

calendar-read.description: See the events of calendars set to signed-in visibility, in the calendar view, the API and the .ics feed
calendar-read.label: See events of calendars shown to signed-in people

calendar-reserve.description: Make and cancel your own reservations
calendar-reserve.label: Make and cancel your own reservations

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Calendar viewing
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Every signed-in account sees the events of calendars whose visibility is authenticated

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Calendar reservations
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Make and cancel one's own reservations

_comment_calendar_read: #2391 — calendar-read: see the events of a calendar whose visibility is authenticated. Granted to every signed-in account; a calendar whose visibility is private asks calendar-manage, and a public one asks nothing.
_comment_calendar_reserve: #1430 — calendar-reserve: make and cancel one's own reservation. Delegated on day one to every role that can sign in; calendar-manage stays the management action.
